description.zh-CN: Google 的终端 AI 编码助手。装进版本目录，不污染全局 npm。
description.en-US: Google terminal AI coding agent. Installed into a version directory.

notes.zh-CN: @google/gemini-cli 只发 npm 包，没有独立二进制，所以用 npm 装进版本目录（不污染全局 npm）。装完在终端里敲的命令是 `gemini`（激活后）。devkit 固定的是顶层包 tarball 的 SHA-256 与版本号；但 npm 在安装时仍会去 registry 解析该包的依赖与平台二进制（例如 claude-code 本体只有 0.2 MB，真正的可执行文件在 平台专用可选依赖里）—— **这一部分不在 devkit 的校验范围内**。这是 npm 生态的固有特性，与"官方直链 + SHA-256"的模型不等价，选之前请知悉。安装需要机器上有 Node.js（npm 随它一起提供）。
notes.en-US: @google/gemini-cli ships only as an npm package with no standalone binary, so it is installed with npm into a version directory (your global npm stays clean). devkit pins the top-level tarball's SHA-256 and version, but npm still resolves that package's dependencies and platform binary from the registry at install time (claude-code itself is only 0.2 MB; the real executable lives in a platform-specific optional dependency) — **that part is outside devkit's verification**. This is inherent to the npm ecosystem and is NOT equivalent to the "official direct link + SHA-256" model. Node.js is required (npm ships with it).
